scope: General memory integrity, source lineage and durable task recovery in the actual working checkout; not paper-case answer tuning or full product acceptance.

fixes.implementation: The SQLite long-horizon backend stores scope-local normalized-summary fingerprints after explicit edits/deletes; automatic consolidation cannot recreate/reinforce retired content, including already-existing active duplicate summaries. Recall, graph-neighbor and cognition input filters exclude retired content. Explicit edit/restore APIs can authorize a return.
fixes.limit: Exact normalized stored-summary matching only; not semantic contradiction detection or prevention of every paraphrased stale memory.

fixes.implementation: Version/time-bound dependencies connect confirmed notes to generated answers, subsequent history-only answers, and reconfirmed notes. Correction, expiry, deletion or source withdrawal invalidates dependent history/replay and removes proof cards. The actual paired historical input is not resent on memory invalidation. Generation and metadata-write races are rechecked without a second model call.
fixes.limit: This prevents reuse/display at supported entry points; it is not physical erasure of every original conversation, audit record, backup or external provider copy.

fixes.implementation: An answer's required-memory-lineage flag is persisted atomically in answer metadata before its separate lineage record, as well as in SessionManager history. If lineage persistence fails, history-only answers with zero direct-memory count cannot launder forgotten data into new confirmed notes. Service outages and incomplete markers remain hidden.

A confirmed note's source_answer_id must exist in its own private project. Answer-linked document dependencies are inherited and source withdrawal affects historical versions too. The HTTP memory API accepts and returns source_answer_id; omission preserves it and explicit null with cleared source IDs permits an explicitly confirmed independent correction.

Durable run owner_boot migration pauses grants lost across process restarts, including a crash between completed steps. Completed checkpoints survive; previous grants do not authorize fresh work. Durable attempts prevent source/goal refresh from bypassing an unknown provider outcome. Reconciliation only settles the exact terminal request and does not publish stale output or dispatch another call.
First-person English and Chinese decision-recall requests use the existing saved-context retrieval path, while ordinary decision-analysis questions do not invite unrelated recent notes.

algorithms.lineage: Bounded flattened ID/revision/time bindings, connection-local transitive memoization and cycle detection, maximum 128 dependencies per answer; this is not a lifetime memory-storage cap.
algorithms.sqlite_lookups: Composite-key batches of 90 bindings (at most 271 SQL variables); metadata contains IDs and time coordinates, not another private-text copy.
algorithms.ordinary_history: Existing 200-answer/2000-reference history batch tests retain <=3 connections by skipping lineage I/O when no memory dependency exists.
algorithms.retired_fingerprints: Indexed scope/digest lookup and a partial index of unhashed rows; one-time streamed legacy revision migration, not a full revision scan on each recall.
algorithms.concurrency: Explicit memory edit/delete/restore and automatic consolidation serialize check/write with BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

new_domain_scenarios: Customer deadline change and document withdrawal
Work/personal task checkpoints after process restart
Unknown provider results and source/goal changes
Different private worker databases and project isolation

memory_scope_boundary.desktop_legacy: Existing personal user/project scopes persist across chats in one private worker database; default read scopes remain session/project/user and default writes remain session unless explicitly requested.
memory_scope_boundary.mobile_research: The existing explicitly confirmed ResearchStore remains session scoped; this patch does not silently share its notes across chats.
memory_scope_boundary.tenancy: Separate private worker databases were tested. user:default/project:default in the legacy backend are not proof of multi-tenant isolation inside a single database.

remaining_product_acceptance: Unify the user-facing desktop/mobile personal-memory contract and consent model; existing backend scopes differ.
Validate semantic event associations and useful retrieval across independent long-duration tasks; version/source lifecycle tests do not certify causal reasoning quality.
Run sustained real-user, device and load acceptance before a production-readiness claim.
Legacy untracked conversation dependencies cannot be retroactively inferred with semantic certainty.
